recentFailed: Recent records could not be loaded.
createBookHelp: Create a lab book and choose its type.
detailsHelp: Name this workspace and describe the work it brings together. Projects and lab books keep their own names; the website title is set in the website editor.
name: Workspace name
referenceHelp: Copy a reference to link to this workspace from a record. It contains a stable identifier, without a local folder path.
newProjectHelp: A new project starts in its own folder. Choose its name and location before creating it.
organizeHelp: An existing project keeps its lab books and records; only its name and introduction are replaced. A new project starts empty.
copyLogos: Copy workspace logos to the project, replacing its current logos
uploadPending: Wait for the current media upload to finish before changing the workspace structure.
saveBeforeOrganizing: There are newer unsaved edits. Save them before reorganizing.
copyLogosSummary: Copy workspace logos to this project
preserveContent: Existing record IDs, contents, attachments and publication selections stay in place.
